run_evaluator_compute: run the Evaluator compute method to evaluate a model pipeline on a dataset with a specified metric
build_evaluator_pipeline: build a transformers pipeline for a given task using the Evaluator prepare_pipeline method
test_bootstrap_confidence: test the Evaluator bootstrap strategy to compute confidence intervals for metric scores
create_evaluator_instance: create an Evaluator instance for a specific NLP task with a default metric name
summarize_performance_metrics: summarize pipeline performance metrics including latency and throughput from the Evaluator call_pipeline method
